_doc: Per-business brand hue for SavedWallet card grounds, extracted from each place's Google photo by scripts/build-place-hues.ts (npm run build:place-hues). Dominant vibrant hue, clamped to S 0.35-0.75 / L 0.30-0.55, guaranteed WCAG AA 4.5:1 for cream text on the wallet's 60% ink mix. Absent slug = no photo or no confident brand hue; the wallet falls back to its category ground. Do not hand-edit; re-run the script.
